
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/formulahendry/p/19969134" title="发布于 2026-05-03 16:55">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">ACP UI 大战 VS Code Agents app：谁才是真正的跨平台 Agent 客户端？</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span>大家好！我是韩老师。</span></p>
<p><span>首先，再次祝大家五一劳动节快乐！</span></p>
<p><span>既然是劳动节，韩老师也是没闲着，继续玩玩自己的项目。</span></p>
<p><span>5月1号的时候，我和大家分享了 ACP UI 已经支持作为<span>原生 iOS/Android 应用，连上<span>任意远程的 Agent：</span></span></span></p>
<p><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIwODE4Nzg2NQ==&amp;mid=2650564805&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=53a67fb87f88391b4076d619e049f552&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-itemshowtype="0" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">在iOS/安卓上远程连接任何 Agent！Claude、Codex、Copilot、Gemini、OpenCode 等</a></span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span>就在今天，我很高兴地和大家分享一个好消息：</span></p>
<p><strong>ACP UI 已正式支持 Web 端！</strong></p>
<p><a href="https://acp-ui.github.io/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><span><span>https://acp-ui.github.io/</span></span></a></p>
<p><span>无论是从桌面浏览器还是手机浏览器，访问上面的网页，就能连上任何远程的 ACP Agent 了！</span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1857417/202605/1857417-20260503165156480-1530787416.png" alt="image" width="939" height="504" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span>那么，再回到文章的标题。</span></p>
<p><span>ACP UI 和 VS Code Agents app，到底哪家强？！</span></p>
<p><span>相信不少童鞋应该知道，VS Code 最近出了一个独立的 Agents app：</span><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzU1NjgwNTExNQ==&amp;mid=2247499195&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=68586a58c554d0bf075227726241b891&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-itemshowtype="0" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">VS Code 1.118 发布！Agents app 全面更新，支持 Claude agent、Web client 甚至是 Mobile</a></span></p>
<p><span>不过，我使用了<span>《<span><span>米氏对比法<span><span>》，把我的 ACP UI 和 VS Code Agents app进行了比较。</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span>竟然发现，ACP UI 吊打&nbsp;<span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">VS Code Agents app！<img src="https://res.wx.qq.com/t/wx_fed/we-emoji/res/assets/newemoji/Yellowdog.png" alt="Image" width="28" height="28" class="rich_pages wxw-img" data-src="https://res.wx.qq.com/t/wx_fed/we-emoji/res/assets/newemoji/Yellowdog.png#imgIndex=5" data-ratio="1" data-w="128" data-aistatus="1" data-original-style="display: inline-block; font-size: 22px; width: 1em; height: 1em; vertical-align: middle; background-size: 1em; background-repeat: no-repeat; margin-top: -0.2em;" data-index="8"><img src="https://res.wx.qq.com/t/wx_fed/we-emoji/res/assets/newemoji/Yellowdog.png" alt="Image" width="28" height="28" class="rich_pages wxw-img" data-src="https://res.wx.qq.com/t/wx_fed/we-emoji/res/assets/newemoji/Yellowdog.png#imgIndex=5" data-ratio="1" data-w="128" data-aistatus="1" data-original-style="display: inline-block; font-size: 22px; width: 1em; height: 1em; vertical-align: middle; background-size: 1em; background-repeat: no-repeat; margin-top: -0.2em;" data-index="8"><img src="https://res.wx.qq.com/t/wx_fed/we-emoji/res/assets/newemoji/Yellowdog.png" alt="Image" width="28" height="28" class="rich_pages wxw-img" data-src="https://res.wx.qq.com/t/wx_fed/we-emoji/res/assets/newemoji/Yellowdog.png#imgIndex=5" data-ratio="1" data-w="128" data-aistatus="1" data-original-style="display: inline-block; font-size: 22px; width: 1em; height: 1em; vertical-align: middle; background-size: 1em; background-repeat: no-repeat; margin-top: -0.2em;" data-index="8"></span></span></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">（手动狗头保命<img src="https://res.wx.qq.com/t/wx_fed/we-emoji/res/assets/newemoji/Worship.png" alt="Image" width="18" height="18" class="rich_pages wxw-img" data-src="https://res.wx.qq.com/t/wx_fed/we-emoji/res/assets/newemoji/Worship.png#imgIndex=4" data-ratio="1" data-w="128" data-aistatus="1" data-original-style="display: inline-block; font-size: 22px; width: 1em; height: 1em; vertical-align: middle; background-size: 1em; background-repeat: no-repeat; margin-top: -0.2em;" data-index="7"></span></p>
<h1 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>ACP UI 大战 VS Code Agents app</span></span></h1>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th><span>维度</span></th><th><span>🏆 ACP UI</span></th><th><span>VS Code Agents app</span></th><th><span>胜出</span></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><span>产品定位</span></td>
<td>开放 ACP 客户端<span>：面向所有 ACP-compatible Agent 的通用入口</span></td>
<td>VS Code / Copilot 体系内的 Agents 控制台</td>
<td><span>🏆 ACP UI</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>最新状态</span></td>
<td><span>已独立发布，最新&nbsp;v0.1.14<span>，持续快速迭代</span></span></td>
<td><span>仍处于&nbsp;Preview / Insiders<span>&nbsp;路线</span></span></td>
<td><span>🏆 ACP UI</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>首次公开发布</span></td>
<td>2026-01-31<span>首版发布，独立产品路线清晰</span></td>
<td><span>代码长期在&nbsp;<code><span>microsoft/vscode</span></code><span>&nbsp;内部演进，之前叫 Session app，现在改为 Agents app</span></span></td>
<td><span>🏆 ACP UI</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>跨平台范围</span></td>
<td><span>✅&nbsp;Windows / macOS / Linux / Android / iOS / Web</span></td>
<td><span>✅ Windows / macOS / Linux / Web，但主要依附 VS Code / Insiders 体系</span></td>
<td><span>🏆 ACP UI</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>Web 端</span></td>
<td><span>✅ 直接打开&nbsp;<code><span>https://acp-ui.github.io/</span></code><span>，无需安装</span></span></td>
<td><span>✅ 新增 Web 相关能力，但仍是 VS Code Agents 体系的一部分</span></td>
<td><span>🏆 ACP UI</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>移动端</span></td>
<td><span>✅ Android 已提供 APK；iOS 可源码构建</span></td>
<td><span>❌ 官方 Agents app 重点仍是桌面 / Web，没有独立移动端路线</span></td>
<td><span>🏆 ACP UI</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>Agent 支持面</span></td>
<td><span>✅ 默认 9 个：Copilot、Claude Code、Gemini、Qwen、Auggie、Qoder、Codex、OpenCode、OpenClaw；理论上支持任意 ACP Agent</span></td>
<td><span>✅ Copilot CLI / Copilot Cloud / local / Claude / Codex / agent-host 等，但受 VS Code/Copilot 体系约束</span></td>
<td><span>🏆 ACP UI</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>开放性</span></td>
<td><span>✅ 基于&nbsp;Agent Client Protocol<span>，添加任意 ACP Agent 更自然</span></span></td>
<td><span>⚠️ 依赖 VS Code 的 session provider / agent host / proposed API / Copilot 设置</span></td>
<td><span>🏆 ACP UI</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>配置方式</span></td>
<td><span>✅&nbsp;<code><span>agents.json</span></code><span>&nbsp;/ Settings UI；桌面、移动、Web 都有对应配置路径</span></span></td>
<td><span>⚠️ 依赖 VS Code 配置、provider 注册和内部贡献点</span></td>
<td><span>🏆 ACP UI</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>远程 Agent</span></td>
<td><span>✅ 原生支持&nbsp;<code><span>ws://</span></code><span>&nbsp;/&nbsp;<code><span>wss://</span></code><span>&nbsp;WebSocket Agent，手机和浏览器都能连远程 Agent</span></span></span></td>
<td><span>✅ 有 cloud / remote / agent host 能力，但路径更重、更平台化</span></td>
<td><span>🏆 ACP UI</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>移动/浏览器可靠性</span></td>
<td><span>✅ 前台重连、<code><span>$/ping</span></code><span>&nbsp;keep-alive、WebSocket 断线恢复思路明确</span></span></td>
<td><span>⚠️ 更偏 VS Code 工作台体验，移动浏览器不是核心主战场</span></td>
<td><span>🏆 ACP UI</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>协议调试</span></td>
<td><span>✅ 内置&nbsp;Traffic Monitor<span>，可实时查看 ACP 协议报文</span></span></td>
<td><span>❌ 没有面向 ACP 协议的独立调试面板</span></td>
<td><span>🏆 ACP UI</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>技术栈 / 运行时</span></td>
<td><span>✅ Tauri 2 + Rust 后端 + Vue 前端；桌面使用系统 WebView</span></td>
<td><span>⚠️ Electron / VS Code Workbench 体系，运行时更重</span></td>
<td><span>🏆 ACP UI</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>安装包体积</span></td>
<td><span>✅ 约 MB 级；不捆绑 Chromium</span></td>
<td><span>⚠️ VS Code / Insiders / Electron 体系，体积明显更大</span></td>
<td><span>🏆 ACP UI</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>仓库体量</span></td>
<td><span>✅&nbsp;<code><span>formulahendry/acp-ui</span></code><span>&nbsp;约&nbsp;1.2 MB<span>，代码面清晰</span></span></span></td>
<td><span>⚠️&nbsp;<code><span>microsoft/vscode</span></code><span>&nbsp;约&nbsp;1.24 GB<span>，Agents app 只是庞大工程中的一部分</span></span></span></td>
<td><span>🏆 ACP UI</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>独立性</span></td>
<td><span>✅ 独立 App，可独立下载、独立使用、独立迭代</span></td>
<td><span>⚠️ 依附 VS Code Insiders / VS Code native host / Copilot 生态</span></td>
<td><span>🏆 ACP UI</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>开源协议</span></td>
<td><span>✅ MIT，完整独立开源</span></td>
<td><span>✅ VS Code OSS 部分 MIT，但产品能力与 Copilot/Insiders 绑定</span></td>
<td><span>🤝 平手偏 ACP UI</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>企业生态</span></td>
<td><span>⚠️ 轻量开放，适合快速接入多 Agent</span></td>
<td><span>✅ VS Code / GitHub / Copilot 企业生态强</span></td>
<td><span>🛡 VS Code</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>并行 Session / PR 工作流</span></td>
<td><span>✅ ACP 会话管理，轻量直接</span></td>
<td><span>✅ 多 Agent sessions、worktree 隔离、diff、PR 流程更深度集</span></td>
<td><span>🛡 VS Code</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>用户心智</span></td>
<td><span>✅ “一个客户端连接所有 Agent”</span></td>
<td><span>⚠️ “VS Code 里的 Agents 控制台”</span></td>
<td><span>🏆 ACP UI</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span>综合判断</span></td>
<td>开放、轻量、跨端、移动/Web 领先，多 Agent 兼容性强</td>
<td>生态强，但重、预览态、强绑定 VS Code/Copilot</td>
<td><span>🏆 ACP UI</span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<hr>
<h2><span><span>一句话总结</span></span></h2>
<p>ACP UI 更像是 Agent 时代的“通用遥控器”：轻、开放、跨桌面/移动/Web，能连接各种 ACP Agent；VS Code Agents app 更像是 VS Code/Copilot 生态里的“官方控制台”：强但重，集成深但边界也更重。</p>
<p><span>韩老师厉害吧！<img src="https://res.wx.qq.com/t/wx_fed/we-emoji/res/assets/newemoji/Yellowdog.png" alt="Image" width="28" height="28" class="rich_pages wxw-img" data-src="https://res.wx.qq.com/t/wx_fed/we-emoji/res/assets/newemoji/Yellowdog.png#imgIndex=5" data-ratio="1" data-w="128" data-aistatus="1" data-original-style="display: inline-block; font-size: 22px; width: 1em; height: 1em; vertical-align: middle; background-size: 1em; background-repeat: no-repeat; margin-top: -0.2em;" data-index="8"><img src="https://res.wx.qq.com/t/wx_fed/we-emoji/res/assets/newemoji/Yellowdog.png" alt="Image" width="28" height="28" class="rich_pages wxw-img" data-src="https://res.wx.qq.com/t/wx_fed/we-emoji/res/assets/newemoji/Yellowdog.png#imgIndex=5" data-ratio="1" data-w="128" data-aistatus="1" data-original-style="display: inline-block; font-size: 22px; width: 1em; height: 1em; vertical-align: middle; background-size: 1em; background-repeat: no-repeat; margin-top: -0.2em;" data-index="8"><img src="https://res.wx.qq.com/t/wx_fed/we-emoji/res/assets/newemoji/Yellowdog.png" alt="Image" width="28" height="28" class="rich_pages wxw-img" data-src="https://res.wx.qq.com/t/wx_fed/we-emoji/res/assets/newemoji/Yellowdog.png#imgIndex=5" data-ratio="1" data-w="128" data-aistatus="1" data-original-style="display: inline-block; font-size: 22px; width: 1em; height: 1em; vertical-align: middle; background-size: 1em; background-repeat: no-repeat; margin-top: -0.2em;" data-index="8"></span></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">（再次手动狗头保命</span></p>
<p><span>ACP UI 在 2026 年已经从桌面客户端升级为全平台 ACP Agent 客户端：Windows、macOS、Linux、Android、iOS、Web 全覆盖，默认支持 9 类主流 Agent，并通过 WebSocket 打通远程、手机和浏览器场景。相比之下，VS Code Agents app 虽然从 Session app 升级而来，并增强了并行 session、worktree、PR 等 VS Code 内部体验，但整体仍是 Insiders / Preview 阶段，且强绑定 VS Code 与 Copilot 生态。</span></p>
<p><span>结论：如果看开放性、跨平台、轻量化和多 Agent 兼容，ACP UI 明显更强。<img src="https://res.wx.qq.com/t/wx_fed/we-emoji/res/assets/newemoji/Yellowdog.png" alt="Image" width="28" height="28" class="rich_pages wxw-img" data-src="https://res.wx.qq.com/t/wx_fed/we-emoji/res/assets/newemoji/Yellowdog.png#imgIndex=5" data-ratio="1" data-w="128" data-aistatus="1" data-original-style="display: inline-block; font-size: 22px; width: 1em; height: 1em; vertical-align: middle; background-size: 1em; background-repeat: no-repeat; margin-top: -0.2em;" data-index="8"><img src="https://res.wx.qq.com/t/wx_fed/we-emoji/res/assets/newemoji/Yellowdog.png" alt="Image" width="28" height="28" class="rich_pages wxw-img" data-src="https://res.wx.qq.com/t/wx_fed/we-emoji/res/assets/newemoji/Yellowdog.png#imgIndex=5" data-ratio="1" data-w="128" data-aistatus="1" data-original-style="display: inline-block; font-size: 22px; width: 1em; height: 1em; vertical-align: middle; background-size: 1em; background-repeat: no-repeat; margin-top: -0.2em;" data-index="8"><img src="https://res.wx.qq.com/t/wx_fed/we-emoji/res/assets/newemoji/Yellowdog.png" alt="Image" width="28" height="28" class="rich_pages wxw-img" data-src="https://res.wx.qq.com/t/wx_fed/we-emoji/res/assets/newemoji/Yellowdog.png#imgIndex=5" data-ratio="1" data-w="128" data-aistatus="1" data-original-style="display: inline-block; font-size: 22px; width: 1em; height: 1em; vertical-align: middle; background-size: 1em; background-repeat: no-repeat; margin-top: -0.2em;" data-index="8"></span></p>
<p> <span><br></span><span>最后，你也许会问，韩老师是如何做到的？</span></p>
<p><span>我就说一个单词：<span><span>Tauri&nbsp;</span></span></span></p>
